title: Configuration reference

## Wuji Hand configuration

Edit `src/output_devices/wujihand_output/config/wujihand_ik.yaml`:

```yaml
# Input source (automatically loads the corresponding retarget config)
input_source: "manus"

# Dexterous hand hardware (see below for how to get serial numbers)
left_hand:
  serial_number: "307A377F3333"
  name: "left_hand"

right_hand:
  serial_number: "358137563533"
  name: "right_hand"

# wujihandros2 driver parameters
driver:
  publish_rate: 1000.0          # Driver publish rate (Hz)
  filter_cutoff_freq: 10.0      # Hardware low-pass filter cutoff frequency
  diagnostics_rate: 10.0        # Diagnostics publish rate (Hz)
```

Get hand serial numbers:

```bash
lsusb -v -d 0483:2000 | grep iSerial
```

## Hand retargeting configuration

Config files at `src/output_devices/wujihand_output/config/`:

| Input source | Config file | Note |
|--------------|-------------|------|
| Manus (right) | `retarget_manus_right.yaml` | z rotation: -15 degrees |
| Manus (left) | `retarget_manus_left.yaml` | z rotation: +15 degrees |

Key parameters:

```yaml
optimizer:
  type: "AdaptiveOptimizerAnalytical"

retarget:
  huber_delta: 2.0               # Position Huber threshold (cm)
  huber_delta_dir: 0.5           # Direction Huber threshold
  norm_delta: 0.04               # Velocity regularization weight
  w_pos: 1.0                     # Tip position weight
  w_dir: 10.0                    # Tip direction weight
  w_full_hand: 1.0               # Full hand vector weight

  mediapipe_rotation:
    x: 0.0
    y: 0.0
    z: -15.0                     # Manus right: -15, left: +15

  segment_scaling:               # Finger segment length scaling
    thumb:  [0.98, 1, 1]
    index:  [1.1, 0.989, 1.1]
    middle: [1.10, 0.96, 0.96]
    ring:   [1.1, 0.97, 0.99]
    pinky:  [1.105, 1.15, 1.15]

  lp_alpha: 0.3                  # Low-pass filter coefficient (smaller = smoother)
```

<Callout type="info">
Manus left and right hands use separate config files due to coordinate system differences. When modifying retarget parameters, update both files—all parameters are identical except `mediapipe_rotation.z`.
</Callout>

## Tianji Arm configuration

Edit `src/output_devices/tianji_output/tianji_output/config/tianji_output.yaml`:

```yaml
robot_ip: "192.168.1.190"
```
